programmes.t: Past Hunters: The Block
programmes.d: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: The Nursery and The Closet
programmes.d: A dangerous entity stalks a pregnant woman in her new house. A single mother discovers a terrifying secret trapped in her son's closet. The shocking eyewitness accounts of terrified people whose dream homes have become nightmares.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: Unwanted Guest and Mirror Image
programmes.d: A dangerous poltergeist threatens a newly-blended family. A young woman is tormented by visions of her own gruesome death.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: Trapped and Retreat
programmes.d: Paranormal activity threatens a young nurse caring for a catatonic patient. A young couple falls prey to a demonic presence in a remote cabin.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: The Evil Down Below
programmes.d: A scientist discovers footage on his security camera that even he can't explain; and a sailing ship from the 1800's is home to a ghostly crew.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: The Incubus
programmes.d: Spirits from an abandoned slaughterhouse invade a couple's home. People at a health club work out under the watchful eyes of a cigarette-smoking ghost; and an Ohio woman is violated by a paranormal incubus in her own bedroom.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: I Died in This House
programmes.d: A medium experiences the torture of a prison snitch killed by other inmates. Two soldiers in Iraq are startled by ghostly encounters in abandoned bunkers; and a police officer witnesses paranormal activity in a deserted spa.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Covert Poisoning of An Ex-Russian Spy / The Odd Death of Charles C. Morgan
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane cover the case of a slain ex-spy and the crimes leading to the death of Charles C. Morgan.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Bizarre Disappearance of Bobby Dunbar
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane take an in-depth look at the insane controversy surrounding the disappearance of Bobby Dunbar.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Treacherous Treasure Hunt of Forrest Fenn
programmes.d: Join Ryan and Shane as they attempt to track down the mysterious hidden treasure of Forest Fenn.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Eerie Case of the Watcher
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane take a look at the case of the Watcher, a mysterious stalker who terrorized his neighborhood.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Unusual Australian Shark Arm Murder
programmes.d: Follow along as hosts Ryan and Shane go down under to examine a shark, a speedboat, and a mysterious severed arm.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Suspicious Case of the Reykjavik Confessions
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane discuss six people who confessed to murders that don't seem to have ever occurred.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Shocking Florida Machete Murder / The Puzzling Disappearance of Walter Collins
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane discuss the Florida machete murder and what became of the missing boy named Walter Collins.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Ghosts of Bolton Sea Cadets
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension team heads to Bolton to check out the alleged haunting at Sea Cadets academy.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Haunted Weir Mill
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension team visits Weir Mill, the oldest and most paranormally active mill in Stockport.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 1
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension team travels to Derbyshire to investigate the New Mills Arts Theatre. This quirky little building has played host to many famous acts and world-renowned plays but has a little-known secret in that it's allegedly haunted.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 2
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension Team is ready for act II at the New Mills Arts Theatre. With so much apparent activity happening at this unassuming theatre, the team just couldn't leave when so much more could happen.

programmes.t: Celebrity Ghost Stories: Ice-T and Coco
programmes.d: Psychic medium Kim Russo meets with rapper and actor Ice-T and his wife Coco as they explore a New Jersey factory and experience unexplainable events linked to the factory's deadly past.

programmes.t: Celebrity Ghost Stories: Terry Bradshaw
programmes.d: Along with his wife Tammy, football and broadcasting legend Terry Bradshaw calls upon psychic medium Kim Russo to gain clarity on the paranormal activity occurring on their Oklahoma ranch.

programmes.t: Celebrity Ghost Stories: Paula Abdul
programmes.d: Music icon Paula Abdul brings psychic medium Kim Russo back to her former California home where she was troubled by incessant spirits.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Osama Bin Laden
programmes.d: Richard investigates claims that the supposed mastermind behind the 9/11 terrorist attacks and leader of the Al Qaeda terrorist cell remained a CIA asset until his death.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Dangers of EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequencies)
programmes.d: Can radiation from electrical appliances, power lines, microwave ovens, and wireless technology such as cell phones, baby monitors, alter our DNA, and cause illnesses?

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Alien Abductions
programmes.d: Richard speaks with two alleged alien abductees about their claims they were taken aboard an alien space craft.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Crop Circles
programmes.d: For centuries, farmers have been discovering strange, complex geometric patterns comprised of rings, circles and other intricate shapes in their fields.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Star Child Skull
programmes.d: Richard meets the owners of an abnormal humanoid skull allegedly discovered in Mexico in the 1930s and a researcher who has had the skull subjected to numerous tests including carbon-14 dating, and DNA in order to determine it’s origin.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Mystery of Oak Island
programmes.d: Richard investigates Canada's best-known mysteries, the Oak Island treasure. Also known as the money pit, the site has become one of the world's deepest and most costly archaeological digs.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Energy Healing
programmes.d: Several energy healers claim they are able to produce spontaneous miraculous healing through a laying on of hands. Claims of similar such healing by a man in a remote village in Brazil, known as John of God are also examined.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Execution of MLK and The Framing of James Earl Ray
programmes.d: In this re-examination of the assassination of civil rights leader Martin Luther King, Richard meets several researchers who provide evidence that the convicted gunman, James Earl Ray was not the real triggerman.

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Carnfield Hall
programmes.d: Carnfield Hall is a country house dating from the 15th and 16th Centuries. This private residence turn event hall is using its paranormal activity to draw in business. Are these spirits the old residents?

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
programmes.d: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Ordsall Hall
programmes.d: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: Don't Go Upstairs and Swerve
programmes.d: Two brothers discover a horrifying secret when they inherit a relative's home. A school teacher struggles to learn the identity of the child-like spirit that's stalking her.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: Paralyzed and The Baby Thief
programmes.d: A man suffering from sleep paralysis captures evidence that something is entering his room. A pregnant woman fears something is trying to harm her unborn child.
